matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the density compensation formula in Section 3.2.1, specifically that dividing by √ρ contradicts the goal of penalizing high-density regions. Pred_1 and Pred_2 both address different sections and different mathematical issues (hypersphere constraint geometry and log loss domain issues respectively), so neither detects this defect.

GT2 concerns a conceptual contradiction in Section 3.2.2 about whether boundary features are noisy or informative. Pred_1 flags a geometric constraint error in the same section but addresses the mathematical form of the hypersphere constraint itself, not the characterization of boundary features. This is a different defect at a different locus within the same section.
